arms.policy: pairact-r1 checkpoint chosen by harness.pairact_r1.select_checkpoint on validation

arms.forbidden: teacher, GT pose, partner pose, stage or geometry inputs; any GT/teacher correction of student commands

arms.policy: P2 MJWarp GT pair-carry teacher (same source SHA as P3 collection)
arms.note: GT allowed; reported side by side as the reference, not as a learned result

start_distribution: same generator as P3: each robot 0.3-1.2 m from its assigned beam end

episode_cap_sim_s.rule: cap = 60 (grasp cap, P1 gate) + carry_budget; carry_budget = min(120, ceil10(1.5 x max_k carry_s[k]) + 3.0 (release instruction) + 1.5 (finish)); carry_s[k] = SIM s from handover to the teacher done phase in P2 smoke world k (only worlds whose teacher command sequence completed)
episode_cap_sim_s.if_no_complete_carry: no cap, P5 does not start (report)
episode_cap_sim_s.if_timeout: any smoke world with carry_total_timeout -> carry_budget = 120, recorded
episode_cap_sim_s.implementation: runner runs cap_s + carry_cap_s from the start (60 + 120 = 180). The computed budget 120 is carried by the new adapter candidate pairact_p5_eval (dsh/pairact-p2-carrypath-a-p5 afd7a6e17: r13_detour profile with carry_cap_s 120); existing candidates unchanged.
episode_cap_sim_s.cap_end: an episode reaching the cap is a failure with termination cap_end; it stays in N_eff

success.definition: placed_in_zone_B AND drop_events == 0 AND robot_robot_contacts == 0 (harness/pair_carry_eval.py, GT evaluator only)

definitions.approach: both robots within the registered grasp-approach radius of their assigned ends (beamact4 funnel)
definitions.alignment: both robots pass the nominal alignment check (beamact4 funnel)
definitions.READY: both own learned stage heads declared READY and pinned GO/ACK issued
definitions.grasp: both grippers closed on the beam (beamact4 funnel grasp)
definitions.hold_3s: joint lift held 3 s (P1 gate criterion)
definitions.carry_1m: beam centre moved >= 1.0 m from its post-hold position without a drop event
definitions.door: beam centre passed the door plane (P2 evaluator door_t not None)

funnel.report: count reaching each stage, n/N_eff per arm (denominator_rule), same seed order
funnel.code: student: harness/pairact_student_eval.StudentFunnel (approach/alignment from GT eval-only rows, READY = both learned stage heads READY and GO issued, grasp, hold_3s) + pair_carry_eval funnel (carried_1m without drop, door_passed, success) chained; teacher: pairact_p5_rows.teacher_funnel
funnel.monotone: each stage counts only seeds that reached every earlier recorded stage (chain); a non-monotone row is reported as a recorder fault

report.primary: student n/N_eff and teacher n/N_eff on the same N_eff heldout seeds (denominator_rule); the excluded seeds are listed next to it

exclusions.pre_run_static_check: rule A only (P0/P1 static stance check, experiments/2026-10-21-pairact-p1 README D2 and run_p1.sh static: flagged['overlap'] of static_stance_check.py = every certified grasp stance of one beam end overlaps a box). Applied mechanically to all 20 heldout seeds after the checkpoint SHA is committed and before any P5 rollout; the excluded seed list and the static-check output sha256 are committed before the run. Rule B (11.07 mm) is not used
exclusions.denominator: excluded seeds leave the denominator (N_eff = 20 - excluded), no replacement seed is drawn, both arms use the same N_eff seeds; reported as n/N_eff with the excluded seeds listed
exclusions.no_filter_meaning: 'no filter' (COLLECT_PREREG heldout) means no success filter and no selection by outcome; the pre-registered rule A static exclusion is the only exclusion
exclusions.host_error: one rerun of the same seed; a second HOST_ERROR counts as failure and is reported separately

denominator_rule: v3 (Codex v2 B6): one denominator everywhere (primary, funnel, minimum success): N_eff = 20 - (rule A excluded seeds); N_eff = 20 when nothing is excluded. Reported as n/N_eff with N_eff and the excluded seed list, also when N_eff < 20
heldout_access: no heldout rollout, result, video or log is produced or read before the selected checkpoint SHA256 and OFFLINE_GATE selection.json are committed (commit_before_run); heldout seeds are never collected (COLLECT_PREREG v2 seeds.heldout) and never used for checkpoint selection
minimum_success_claim: >= 1/N_eff student success meets the r1 minimum; 0/N_eff is reported with the funnel as the result
compute_estimate_gpu_h: 2-3 for both arms (pair-act-carry-plan.md P5). Verified 2026-10-25 against measured flow-runner rates: 39-40 world gate batches ran at 0.55-0.66 aggregate SIM s per wall s (loop 2300-2950 s for <=600-tick episodes); P2 smoke 3 worlds x ~343 SIM s took 2004 s wall. For 20-world batches with episodes <= 180 SIM s this gives roughly student 1.0-1.3 GPU-h + teacher 0.9-1.1 GPU-h, inside the 2-3 GPU-h approved 2026-10-24.

student_correction_audit.unknown: a null counter means unverified: the episode is not a success and the hybrid rule returns UNVERIFIED_CORRECTIONS
student_correction_audit.nonzero: any nonzero counter invalidates the student arm (INVALID_STUDENT_CORRECTED); reported, no student number is claimed
student_correction_audit.static: student-eval.json has exactly the 6 registered keys (no GT/teacher/partner key); worker process isolated, STUDENT_SHA pinned

training_tier_link: TRAIN_PLAN.json tiers: the headline is success n/N_eff for TRAIN / TRAIN_DATA_RANGE_LIMITED and the funnel for TRAIN_SMALL_DATA; NO_TRAIN* has no P5
